_help: templates: {city} is replaced by each city name. cities: name used in the query -> Google's canonical location (only used by --engine google). pages: result pages per query, 10 links each.

extract._help: follow_links_per_page: when a result page has no structured events, how many event links on it to open. keep_outside_india: keep events whose address is in another country. description_chars: trim descriptions to this length.
